item.title: 【Albums (lossy)】M4A - Wicked - The Complete Soundtrack
item.description:
I compiled the two soundtracks (the first one being the bonus track edition including the edit versions of Popular and Defying Gravity) into a single album, so we can get to experience the whole musical as one thing only - like the Broadway album.
I hope you guys enjoy it as much as I do Plus I included two covers, the other without "The Complete Soundtrack" text, so you can choose which one you prefer and use it.
